nepaliKitchenUses: Morning Soaked Anjeer Ritual: Soak 2 whole Dry Figs overnight in half a cup of water along with 4–5 Raw Almonds. Eat the soft figs in the morning and drink the mineral-rich soaking water.

monsoonStorage: Whole dried figs contain natural fruit sugars that can crystallize on the surface ("sugaring") or soften in high humidity. Store in a tightly sealed jar in a cool cupboard, or place in the refrigerator during hot, humid monsoon months.

faqs.q: What is the price of Dry Figs (Anjeer / अन्जीर) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Dry Figs (Anjeer) 200 GM pack costs Rs. 850 in Nepal (which equals Rs. 425 per 100g). We deliver across Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan, and all 77 districts.

faqs.q: How many pieces of Anjeer should I eat per day (दैनिक कति ओटा अन्जीर खाने)?
faqs.a: Most adults enjoy 2 to 3 soaked Dry Figs per day—typically soaked overnight in water and eaten first thing in the morning.

faqs.q: Why should Anjeer be soaked overnight in water?
faqs.a: Soaking rehydrates the soluble fiber and softens the outer skin, making the fig gentler on morning digestion and easier to chew.

faqs.q: Is white powder on dried figs normal or mold?
faqs.a: A light dusty white frost on dried figs over time is natural fruit-sugar crystallization ("sugaring"), not mold. Keeping the pack sealed in the fridge during warm months prevents sugar crystallization.

faqs.q: How many whole figs are in a 200 GM pack?
faqs.a: Depending on individual fruit size, a 200 GM pack contains approximately 18 to 24 whole dried fig rings (enough for 9–12 days at 2 figs per day).
